resources.identity: Per request: private timer/controller, borrowed caller signal, manual fetch responses.
resources.lifecycle: Validate before timer/fetch. Private controller plus borrowed caller signal via AbortSignal.any preserves first reason. One timer covers headers, hops and bodies; buffered/binary finally clears it. Wrapper owns body consumption; native fetch owns connection pooling. Abort stops local transport, not proof remote effect absent.
invariants: First abort reason retained; timer cleared; cancellation is local, remote effects uncertain.
failure_scenarios: Caller abort then delayed fetch rejection after timer: caller error preserved.

resources.identity: Per response: locked reader/chunks/count; stream decoder and iterator.
resources.lifecycle: Buffered EOF/read-error finally releases lock; overcap awaits best-effort cancel then throws quota. Streaming incomplete exit cancels/releases; EOF releases without cancel; outer finally clears timer. Generator first next creates resources. Suspended yield cannot independently run finally. Arbitrary custom-stream cancellation is outside native-fetch proof.
invariants: Quota never truncated; early return cancels/releases; abandoned suspended iterator separately owned.
failure_scenarios: status/body overcap: no truncation/salvage; reader cancellation then quota.

resources.identity: Fixed origin; mutable hop URL/method/body, count, auth/idempotency headers.
resources.lifecycle: Manual redirect, omit credentials, fixed origin. Location bodies drain bounded before origin/count check; quota/timeout/caller abort stop chain, other drain errors best effort. POST301/302 and303 become GET;307/308 preserve body. Missing Location uses status reader. Same-origin path changes permitted; auth/idempotency headers remain.
invariants: Fixed origin, max5 hops, method policy, no retry; endpoint paths may change.
failure_scenarios: POST /send accepts remotely then302 /send-final GET stalls: unknown transport completion; first-hop effect cannot be undone.

resources.identity: Runtime delivery ID; frozen request/finalized refs and resolved aggregate size.
resources.lifecycle: Preflight all attachment refs/sizes/quota before POST /send; copied frozen request, wire/header same delivery ID. Typed errors/completions mapped then validated; unexpected errors rethrow after HTTP cleanup. One reconcile GET same encoded ID: accepted/reference, rejected/404 failed, pending unknown. No attachment descriptors, retry loop or durable journal owned.
invariants: Attachment preflight before send; original delivery ID for uncertainty/reconcile.
failure_scenarios: Provider records ID d then connection/deadline fails: unknown(d); reconcile d accepted -> succeeded(d).

resources.identity: Local delivery ID; copied state/questions and allowlisted model.
resources.lifecycle: Freeze bounded batch, POST once; validate all answer associations before facts. Typed transport uncertainty mapped, unexpected exceptions propagate after HTTP cleanup. Reconcile validates ID then returns no_run_resume unknown without network. Local completion ID is not provider deduplication.
invariants: No partial answer fact, retry or invented durable lookup.
failure_scenarios: Remote computes but body/deadline lost: unknown same local ID; reconcile no_run_resume.

resources.identity: Local delivery ID; frozen authorized history/model/maxTokens.
resources.lifecycle: Freeze authorized history/model; POST stream:false once. Validated final completion only; typed errors mapped and unexpected errors propagate. Reconcile returns no_run_resume unknown without network. Local ID neither provider lookup nor remote deduplication.
invariants: Validated final only; local ID not remote deduplication.
failure_scenarios: Provider completes generation then response lost: unknown; reconcile cannot prove remote state.

resources.owner: Ollama run handle / NDJSON / snapshot tail
resources.identity: Per-run controller/settled promise; terminal, content/NDJSON buffer, snapshot tail<=256.
resources.lifecycle: Constructor emits running and immediately drives HTTP NDJSON. First terminal retained; terminal return closes iterator. EOF without final fails; malformed/provider errors preserve partial snapshots; transport uncertainty unknown. Per-run cancel aborts then awaits settled; already terminal wins. Observer throws swallowed; unexpected errors can reject done without terminal snapshot. Request/content/tail remain until caller drops handle.
invariants: First terminal stands; partial text is evidence; each run independently cancelled.
failure_scenarios: Valid final processed then cancel: first succeeded completion remains.

resources.identity: Local delivery ID; supplied/minted remote prompt ID; reviewed graph/mapping/client ID.
resources.lifecycle: Validate mapping/input and ID, then POST /prompt with supplied/minted prompt_id; no retry. Unknown envelope has null result, losing default-minted ID to caller. Supplied persisted ID permits recovery. Accepted response prompt_id returned without comparison to submitted ID; legitimate provider rewrite policy unresolved. No automatic polling.
invariants: Caller-restorable prompt ID required for uncertain submit recovery.
failure_scenarios: POST prompt_id j accepted, connection lost: unknown(d), caller with persisted j can poll history j.

resources.identity: Encoded job path; history, bounded descriptors, sequential bytes/position map.
resources.lifecycle: One history request: absent unknown, executing running, overcount failed without downloads. Sequential binary requests stop first failure/empty bytes, preserve earlier bytes with incomplete marker. Each request has deadline; whole observation no timer. Failed run is succeeded observation/result.state failed. Cancel POST captures requested/404unsupported/uncertain then reconciles; never fabricates cancelled. Returned bytes caller-owned.
invariants: Cancel is request then observation; partial outputs explicit, count/file caps retained.
failure_scenarios: Cancel200 then history completed: completed still wins; response alone not proof stopped.

resources.identity: Validated cursor/limit; borrowed loader result.
resources.lifecycle: Validate before one borrowed loader; validate page afterward; propagate failures, no truncation/retry/iteration/cursor cache. Callback owns its clients/streams; helper provides no arbitrary callback cleanup.
invariants: Reject invalid request before loader; callback owns its resources.
failure_scenarios: Loader acquires resources then rejects: helper propagates; no source promise it joins arbitrary callback cleanup.

resources.identity: Loopback server, sockets/logs/state; model timer Set, mail untracked timer.
resources.lifecycle: Loopback server owns sockets and request logs; capped request read destroys oversize. close destroys sockets then awaits server.close; model also clears tracked timers. Mail drip timer untracked: survives close until expiry but checks destroyed response. Media/judgment no timed progression. Fixtures are not live-provider disposal proof.
invariants: Caller closes fixture; no credit as live provider disposal.
failure_scenarios: Start mail drip delay60000 then close immediately: sockets close, but referenced timer can survive to expiry; no live provider-path claim.

resources.identity: No implemented owned provider worker in absent/contract-only families.
resources.lifecycle: Catalog implements Email/Chat/SystemOne/Images only; Payments/Errors contract-only. No document/source/report/tracker provider worker here. CF contextual effect stubs throw unsupported. Missing worker creates no disposal success to credit; authorized durable joins remain product duties owned by root/work audit.

failure_scenarios: Authored payment/refund/cancel/reconcile or document/source/report/tracker workflow requires mounted provider+durable ownership; absent adapter is a join gap, not simulated success.

resources.owner: TS portable bundle / Bun scratch builds
resources.identity: Per-call module/asset/map inventory; two unique scratch roots, sync Bun children.
resources.lifecycle: Resolve dists before scratch. mkdtemp then entry write before cleanup try. Sync argv Bun has no explicit timeout. Bun error removes root; outfile read finally removes root before marker/link checks. Cleanup failure may mask original. Module/asset/map buffers per call; no scope-owned cross-call cache. TS build adapter delegates public bundle; held native phases duplicate two helpers.
invariants: Sync API retained; temporary scratch allowed in preview but cleaned on every branch.
failure_scenarios: mkdtemp succeeds then writeFileSync entry fails: root remains; no catch/finally owns it yet.

resources.lifecycle: Compat/confirmation/activation/build/review precede writes; preview returns, compiler mismatch refuses. Confirmed writes bundle then plan/TOML sequentially, no rollback/lock; midwrite throws before Wrangler, prior files persist. yes-gated sync Wrangler timeout180000 returns numeric nonzero as applied:false; spawn errors caught by host. Prepared envelope remains ok:true with applied/status detail. No remote reconciliation.

resources.identity: Rehearsal stage array; borrowed snapshot/store/work inventory; no owned lock.
resources.lifecycle: Default upgrade rehearses six states, no side effects; live ask refuses before store/spawn. Activation reads borrowed snapshot then inventory gate, catches known failures into inactive reasons; missing joins fail closed. No owned checkpoint/lease/admission lock/child/tempfile. Store/producer owns atomicity and lifecycle; gate sequence itself not atomic.
invariants: Rehearsal active is not live checkpoint; borrowed producer owns fencing.
failure_scenarios: Borrowed store read never settles: activate waits indefinitely; no local deadline/cancel contract.

resources.identity: Resolved executable, child/group/piped stdio, kill/grace timer, stderr/close promise.
resources.lifecycle: Spawn empty argv/pipedstdio/detachedPOSIX. Idempotent kill groupTERM/direct fallback then unref KILL2s, never cleared on close. Native job installs close observer early, captures stderr unbounded, awaits close without deadline/exit-status gate. Error kill then fatal process.exit can bypass grace. Probe10s bounds frames only; post-success close wait unbounded; probe does not drain stderr.
invariants: Before adoption bounded joined child/group/stdio/diagnostics cleanup; no started-job TS retry.
failure_scenarios: Prepared then child keeps stdio open: host waits close indefinitely.

resources.identity: Decoder/pending frames/token/waiter/timer; core stdin/stdout and retained node buffers.
resources.lifecycle: Host caps individual frame64MiB, checks handshake/token; per-frame timeout resets and excludes onNeed. stdin writes ignore backpressure; pending queue unbounded. Prepared checks partial tail only, endsstdin/returns; complete pending/later frames unchecked. Finally removes all data/end listeners. Standalone parse/handler/timeout errors detach but do not always kill; wrapper owns cleanup. Core blocking frame I/O caps allocation, token-once/Abort/EOF invalidates job; no native host filesystem resources.
invariants: One job/token once/closed terminal; individual cap not aggregate pending bound.
failure_scenarios: Host sees Need1; onNeed neverresolves; peer emits many <=cap frames: pendingqueue can grow without framewaittimer.

resources.identity: Owned or borrowed staging root; records path/length/hash; destination owned by writer.
resources.lifecycle: Owned mkdtemp or borrowed root. Stage writes validated contained paths/records. Verify compares reviewed buffers with recorded hashes, not current disk or complete key set. Confirmed publish re-reads without hashing and writes sequentially; catches written/pending but current failing file may have partial effects. Dispose marks disposed before rm. Generic sync wrapper finally does not await Promise callbacks.
invariants: Reviewed exact bytes/keyset must publish; preview cannot publish; partial not atomic.
failure_scenarios: Stage x=a, verify x=a, diskreplace x=b, publish: re-read shipsb without rehash.

resources.identity: Persistent staged binary/sidecar/licenses/release and dist manifests; tool cache/lockfile.
resources.lifecycle: Sync toolVersion/Cargo commands have no explicit timeout; pinned Rust/current host and cargo --locked. Persistent stage copy/chmod/hash/sidecar, licenses then releaseJSON are sequential, no transaction/rollback/publication lock. Distmanifest reads/hashes files, direct write. No installed provider, native runtime, live Wrangler, concurrency or process-group behavior executed. Payment/Errors contract-only; document/source/report/tracker adapters absent here.

No adapter automatic retry/background polling; Ollama consumes/closes its iterator, ComfyUI observes once per reconcile. Local IDs alone are not remote durable identity.
No scope-owned publication lock/upgrade checkpoint backend; Cargo --locked and release lockstep are integrity concepts. No source claim native CLI or Worker-vendored subprocess adopted.
